rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice for lovingly pampering someone, without necessarily implying that they are spoiled.

example.english: I always cosset my daughter, arranging everything for her.
example.traditional: 我成日錫住個女，乜都幫佢安排好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 sek3 zyu6 go3 neoi2 mat1 dou1 bong1 keoi5 on1 paai4 hou2

rows.note: Use this when cosseting means indulging someone so much that they become spoiled.

example.english: If you cosset your son like this, he'll end up refusing to do anything for himself.
example.traditional: 你咁樣寵壞個仔，遲早佢乜都唔肯自己做。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 cung2 waai6 go3 zai2 ci4 zou2 keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 hang2 zi6 gei2 zou6

rows.note: Use this for excessive, usually parental love and indulgence, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: Parents who excessively cosset their children often leave them lacking independence.
example.traditional: 父母過分溺愛子女，往往令佢哋欠缺獨立能力。
example.jyutping: fu6 mou5 gwo3 fan6 nik6 oi3 zi2 neoi5 wong5 wong5 ling6 keoi5 dei6 him3 kyut3 duk6 laap6 nang4 lik6
